cases.title: a block signed by a key without rights on the account is refused
a block signed by a key the account granted SEND_ON_BEHALF of the token gets a temporary vote
SEND_ON_BEHALF granted without a target covers a send of the base token
SEND_ON_BEHALF granted for another token does not cover a send of the base token
a grant earlier in the same request covers a block signed by the grantee
SEND_ON_BEHALF granted without a target earlier in the same request covers a send of the base token
a grant of SEND_ON_BEHALF to oneself on one's own account does not cover signing another account's send in the same request
removing SEND_ON_BEHALF from a key earlier in the request does not let that key sign the account's send
a token's send of itself into a storage account needs the storage account's grants like any other
a send into a storage account that granted nothing is refused
a send into a storage account that admits the token but not the sender's deposits is refused
a send into a storage account that admits the sender's deposits but not the token is refused
a send into a storage account gets a temporary vote once its owner admits the token and the sender's deposits
the storage account's grants earlier in the same request admit the send
creating a token and its opening block with info and supply in one request gets a temporary vote
a token's opening block without its creation is refused
creating a token is refused once the network's default permission no longer admits it
a network default narrowed earlier in the same request does not refuse a creation the stored default admits
a mint signed by a key that does not own the token is refused
a send of a token without a default permission to an account without an ACL row is refused
storage contract D10: an ACL row emptied by a SET is stored, and overrides the token's default ACCESS
an ACL row emptied earlier in the same request does not refuse a send the stored default admits
a default permission set earlier in the same request admits the send that needs it, which alone is refused
a multisig granted SEND_ON_BEHALF signs through a quorum of its signers
a multisig signing through fewer signers than its quorum is refused
a multisig signing through a key that is not one of its signers is refused
a multisig without a grant on the account is refused, though a quorum signs
making a second account an owner of a token is refused
handing a token's ownership to another account in one block gets a temporary vote
adding a flag other than OWNER to the sole owner counts as removing it, and is refused
removing the sole owner of a token is refused
an ACL for a certificate its account does not hold is refused
an ACL for a certificate that an earlier block of the same request stores is refused, since the certificate is looked up in storage
a token that admits a certificate's holders refuses a recipient without one, and admits one that holds it
a certificate ACL admits a holder while the holder's certificate is valid, and refuses it once that certificate has expired, while still admitting a holder whose certificate is valid
a TOKEN_ADMIN_MODIFY_BALANCE, signed by the token's owner, is refused as unsupported

a node that enables TOKEN_ADMIN_MODIFY_BALANCE refuses it signed without rights, refuses an owner-signed ADD the token cannot fund, and gives an owner-signed SUBTRACT a temporary vote; a node with default operations refuses it as unsupported
a node whose setRep policy refuses every delegation refuses one, and a node whose policy admits every delegation gives it a temporary vote
delegating to an account that is no representative and has no weight gets a temporary vote
on an empty ledger, the trusted root's opening block for the base token needs no permission
on an empty ledger, the same opening block signed by another key is refused
a permanent request without a fee block is given after the recipient lost its ACCESS
a permanent request with a fee block is refused after the recipient lost its ACCESS, and given by a node that has not seen the loss
an unsupported operation and a negative amount, each signed by a key without rights, are refused for the operation before the permissions
a second owner added by a key without rights is refused for the permissions before the owner count
an overspend and a second owner are refused for the owner count before the balance
an overspend and an ACL for a certificate nobody holds are refused for the certificate before the balance
a token block that grants an ACL for a certificate nobody holds and mints past the maximum supply is refused for the supply
